subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "Good morning, students, "said the teacher. "How are you?" "We are fine. sir, What about you?" "I am too. Please sit down. Have you prepared your lesson?" the teacher asked. "Sorry, sir, we have not prepared our lesson, "they replied.
guide_solution: Rifat asked Sifat what he (S) was reading. Sifat replied that he (S) was reading an interesting drama by Shakespeare and exclaimed with wonder that it was a very interesting drama. He also said that he had collected that from their school library. Rifat requested him (S) to lend him (R) the book.
